verdict.rationale: CMS IndusLaw has a dedicated Intellectual Property practice page that covers trademarks "from strategy and registration to enforcement", which satisfies the core of the story: registration and enforcement handled within a documented practice. The page is a single combined IP page (trademarks alongside patents) rather than a trademark-specific team, and clearance searching is only implied by "strategy". Missing for 10: explicit mention of trademark clearance/searches, a distinct trademark or brand-protection team, and independent corroboration (e.g., rankings or matter examples).
